workflow.name: EE-CRM Multi-Agent SDLC Pipeline
workflow.description: Orchestrates technical stories from planning through failing E2E tests, local implementation, architectural review, full local QA test suite, and human acceptance before production cutover.

worktree.purpose: Enables multiple orchestrations to run in parallel without branch conflicts or dirty working tree collisions.

architect_plan.description: Deep architectural analysis, layer boundary enforcement, and verification checks mapping. Commits plan to main.

qa_red_phase.description: Runs in task worktree. Authors automated End-to-End browser tests (Playwright/Puppeteer) directly mapped to story to-dos, confirmed failing.

architect_review.description: Runs in task worktree. Code diff review against plan, boundary isolation check (UI vs services), and invariant verification.

dev_implementation.description: Runs in task worktree. Full-stack code changes according to plan; uses QA tests locally to double-check until all turn green.

qa_green_phase.description: Runs in task worktree. Executes ALL tests across the entire cumulative verification suite on localhost:3000 to guarantee zero regression.

ba_story_status.description: Updates story status, Definition of Done checklist, and audit trail without reading source code.

terminal_output_control.rule: Avoid dumping massive terminal logs. Run targeted tests with specific paths (e.g. npm test -- <spec>) during iteration. Use git diff --stat or narrow diffs.

ba.rule: BA must never inspect application source code, components, services, or run codebase searches.

architect.rule: Architect is strictly read-only for application code. Prohibited from editing application source files unless requested.

dev.rule: Dev reads files and makes edits directly. Diagnostic probes must have short timeouts (<=5s). Terminate hanging commands immediately via manage_task kill.

qa.rule: QA tests external contracts. On final green-phase verification, QA MUST run ALL tests in the verification suite.
